candidate.answerReason: The common perimeter is 24 cm, giving square side length 6 cm and area 36 cm².

methods.label: Use the common perimeter
methods.explanation:
First find the triangle's perimeter, since the square has that same total boundary length:
\[
6.2+8.3+9.5=24\text{ cm}.
\]
A square has four equal sides, so each side is \(24\div4=6\) cm long. Its area is the side length multiplied by itself:
\[
6\times6=36\text{ cm}^2.
\]
The area is \(36\text{ cm}^2\), choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
